name: Composition
entries: the main subjects spread across the frame from left to right with space between them
one subject in the foreground, the others a step behind in the middle ground
two subjects facing each other from the two sides of the frame
the subjects in a diagonal line from the near corner to the far side of the frame
three main visual anchors forming a triangle in the frame, with the subjects and shared objects supplying the anchors without adding people
the main subject framed by a doorway, arch or window in the foreground
a low object in the foreground, the main subject behind it and the background far behind
the main subject off-center, open space on the other side of the frame
the main subject seen through a gap between foreground objects
the subjects at different visible heights along an existing staircase or slope, each supported on its own step or patch of ground
the main subject and its reflection visible together in a mirror, window or still water, with their positions consistent with the reflecting surface
the main subject small at the bottom of the frame under a large sky or ceiling
the shared object near the center of the frame, with the participants' separate hands leading toward it from different sides
the subjects arranged along an open arc in the frame, leaving their shared working area visible in the center
parallel edges in the setting leading toward the main subjects without crossing their faces or obscuring their interaction
a clear gap between each subject's silhouette and nearby background edges, keeping their limbs and contact points distinct
